name: Mario Vargas Llosa
role: Peruvian-Spanish novelist, liberal political essayist and presidential candidate (1990)
summary: Vargas Llosa moved from revolutionary socialism to democratic liberalism, defending markets, civil liberties and constitutional restraints. His mature views combined social liberalism and open migration with opposition to authoritarian government and qualified support for intervention against tyranny.

sources.title: Confessions of a Latin American Liberal (2014)
sources.author: Mario Vargas Llosa / Lindau Nobel Laureate Meetings
sources.usedFor: Markets, individual liberty, checks on power and pension privatization.

sources.title: The Culture of Liberty (2001)
sources.author: Mario Vargas Llosa / Foreign Policy, hosted by Columbia University
sources.usedFor: Cultural pluralism, globalization and rejection of imposed national identity.

sources.title: No se le pueden pedir al pueblo argentino más sacrificios (2018 interview)
sources.author: Mario Vargas Llosa interviewed by Loreley Gaffoglio and Astrid Pikielny / La Nación
sources.usedFor: Abortion, drugs, assisted dying, social protection and technological culture.

sources.title: La pena de muerte no debe aplicarse en ningún caso (2018 interview)
sources.author: Mario Vargas Llosa interviewed by Raúl Tola / El Comercio
sources.usedFor: Capital punishment, public education, independent judges and presidential accountability.

sources.title: Entrevista a Mario Vargas Llosa (2018)
sources.author: Mario Vargas Llosa interviewed by Elena Cué / Alejandra de Argos
sources.usedFor: Democracy, reform, state planning, European integration and individual choices.

sources.title: En nombre de la autodefensa se destruye la democracia (2019 interview)
sources.author: Mario Vargas Llosa interviewed by Jesús Ceberio / El País
sources.usedFor: Land redistribution, private smallholders and criticism of Guatemala’s coup.

sources.title: ¿Se acaba la guerra? (2022)
sources.author: Mario Vargas Llosa / El Informador, syndicated from El País
sources.usedFor: Rejection of Russian domination and recognition of Ukraine’s freedom to join alliances.

sources.title: Vargas Llosa y Pamuk critican a la UE por los refugiados (2016)
sources.author: Europa Press
sources.usedFor: His own remarks advocating open immigration and rejecting racial prejudice.

sources.title: El ejemplo del puma (2005)
sources.author: Mario Vargas Llosa / El País
sources.usedFor: Conservation compatible with science and industry, rejecting primitivist ecology.

sources.title: El asalto interminable (2023)
sources.author: Mario Vargas Llosa / El País

sources.title: Mario Vargas Llosa
